report:
Reassessed the complete fixed_projection claim, both ordinary implementation entries and the sole associated TODO test. Verified exact byte equality of current sage-emit/src/lib.rs, sage-oracle/src/emit.rs and service_spec.rs against the supplied historical input by joining its stored lines with newline characters; the previous rationale remains applicable, with the limitations below.

Source inspection: emit_module constructs the Sage Emitter from Db and native module/typed bodies; emit_crate constructs the rustc Emitter from TyCtxt and native HIR/typeck results. Neither accepts or reads the peer output. Local registration and explicit external definition-kind mappings translate identities independently. Both map alias categories and type arguments, preserve resolved-call dispatch and owner/method substitutions, and represent dereference/borrow/never adjustments using their own inputs; rustc operator conversion uses native resolution and language items. Reference emission deliberately omits lifetime identity on both sides, as permitted by this claim. Thus the visible mappings are fixed rather than conditional on observed mismatches. Missing vocabulary is not established as fully repaired: unsupported expression markers, skipped item kinds and other limited cases remain outside a completed projection audit. The rule requiring schema growth with both projections remains an obligation for extending support, not a demonstrated blanket completeness result.

The complete associated test set is sage_meta::todo::crates_sage_oracle_harness_crate_fixed_projection. Its body has no behavioral assertion and explicitly defers complete adapter-focused evidence for native kinds, substitutions, receiver adjustments, overloadable operators, lifetimes and unsupported constructs, plus adversarial one-sided omissions or wrong classifications remaining exact mismatches. Those are the prerequisites for closing the gap: associate/review meaningful adapter fixtures and independent mismatch assertions, extending shared vocabulary and both projections where necessary. A shared unsupported marker is not proof that distinct unsupported cases remain distinguishable. Accept the existing explicit deferral, rather than treating the placeholder as a passing coverage test or claiming complete schema/projection conformance. No N/A entries exist.

Execution: personally ran review start with the supplied instructions, review read for the review contract, and exact-source comparisons; no behavior tests or workspace build were run by this reviewer. The coordinator-reported 321 passing sage-meta tests and root build are separate baseline execution evidence, not verification of the deferred adapter scenarios. All source dependencies used in this assessment are captured in the initial fragments or recorded read. No immediate edits to the existing TODO accounting are required.
